1bb85220a11a403a.description: About the Role TP-Link Saudi Arabia is seeking a Channel Account Manager to join its team in the Eastern Region, based in Dammam or Al Khobar. This full-time role focuses on driving business growth, developing channel partnerships, expanding market coverage, and achieving sales targets for TP-Link's Omada Business Networking and VIGI Video Surveillance solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute channel sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets. Manage and strengthen relationships with distributors, resellers, system integrators, CCTV installers, and ELV contractors. Identify, onboard, and develop new channel partners to expand market coverage and product penetration. Drive sell-in, sell-out, inventory management, and channel partner productivity. Identify and develop project opportunities across SMB, enterprise, hospitality, education, retail, and commercial segments. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and ensure timely opportunity conversion. Conduct regular market visits, partner meetings, product presentations, and business reviews. Collaborate with Presales, Product Management, and Marketing teams to drive business development and channel engagement. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and emerging business opportunities. Prepare accurate sales forecasts and weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual business reports. Continuously upgrade product knowledge, technical understanding, and sales competencies. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant role. Strong background in the CCTV and video surveillance industry. Established relationships with distributors, system integrators, resellers, CCTV installers, and security solution providers. Product Line Expertise The role requires expertise in the following TP-Link product lines: Business Networking Product Line (Omada): Including Business Wi-Fi solutions, access points, managed switches, gateways, controllers, cloud-managed networking, and enterprise network infrastructure. Video Surveillance Product Line (VIGI): Including IP cameras, NVRs, video management solutions, CCTV systems, and integrated surveillance solutions. Integrated Solutions: Ability to identify cross-selling opportunities by combining networking and surveillance solutions to meet customer and project requirements. Work Location This position is based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, specifically in Dammam or Al Khobar.

1b3cb4549993f939.job_title: Project Management Consultant Buildings & Master Planning
1b3cb4549993f939.description: About Worley Worley is a global company specializing in energy, chemicals, and resources, headquartered in Australia. The company partners with clients to deliver projects and create value across the lifecycle of their assets, offering expertise in consulting, engineering, procurement, and construction. Worley supports customers in navigating complex challenges and transitioning to sustainable solutions through extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery. Project Manager – Master Planning & Facilities Worley is seeking an experienced Project Manager for the Master Planning & Facilities Service Line in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role supports clients in the planning, development, and delivery of complex built-environment and infrastructure projects, integrating master planning, architecture, engineering, and specialist disciplines. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in Architecture, Master Planning, Urban Planning, Infrastructure, or a related built-environment discipline, combined with proven Project Management and/or Design Management experience. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage multidisciplinary Master Planning, Architecture, Facilities, and Infrastructure projects from early studies and concept development through design and delivery. Manage project scope, programme, resources, budget, deliverables, and interfaces in accordance with Worley procedures and client requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including master planning, architecture, civil, structural, MEP, transport, landscape, and other specialist disciplines. Lead or support study management, optioneering, concept development, design reviews, and resolution of multidisciplinary design interfaces. Ensure deliverables achieve required quality, schedule, and cost objectives; maintain project execution plans, resource forecasts, action registers, and progress reporting. Proactively identify and manage project, technical, programme, commercial, and stakeholder risks, with clear mitigation actions, owners, and follow-up. Identify changes in scope and manage their programme, resource, and commercial impacts, supporting variations/change orders where appropriate. Monitor project performance including progress, hours, costs, and forecast-to-complete, taking corrective action when required. Prepare and deliver high-quality reports, presentations, workshops, and client communications. Promote productivity, cost effectiveness, digital solutions, lessons learned, and continuous improvement in project delivery. Work effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams; travel internationally when required for client meetings, workshops, and project activities. Support proposals, fee estimates, resource planning, and business development activities where required. Qualifications and Experience Education: Degree in Architecture, Master Planning, Urban Planning, Civil Engineering, or another relevant built-environment/infrastructure discipline. Experience: Relevant professional experience in infrastructure, master planning, buildings, or facilities, with demonstrable experience in Project Management and/or Design Management. Technical Understanding: Strong understanding of multidisciplinary design processes and interfaces between architecture, master planning, and engineering disciplines. Team Coordination: Experience coordinating and managing multidisciplinary design teams and complex technical interfaces. International Projects: Experience working on international projects, preferably with geographically distributed teams and multiple stakeholders. Project Management Capability: Strong project management capability covering scope, programme, resources, cost/budget, risk, change, and quality management. Communication: Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to produce clear professional reports, presentations, and client correspondence. Skills: Strong client-facing, stakeholder-management, organisational, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Attributes: Proactive, accountable, and able to manage competing priorities in a dynamic project environment; effective team player in multicultural teams. Preferred Qualifications PMP or another recognised Project Management qualification. Professional registration or chartership in Architecture, Planning, Engineering, or another relevant discipline. Previous experience as a Project Manager, Design Manager, Architect, Master Planner, or multidisciplinary Design Lead. Experience delivering projects across the Middle East and/or EMEA region. Experience in major master plans, urban development, buildings, facilities, or complex infrastructure developments. Experience supporting proposals, fee estimates, resource planning, and project commercial management. Personal Attributes Proactive and accountable, anticipating issues and driving actions through to completion. Collaborative team player able to build strong relationships across disciplines, offices, and cultures. Client-focused and commercially aware, balancing client priorities with scope, programme, budget, and project performance.

1bd15f24f97f97c0.description: About the Role Alan is expanding its operations into Saudi Arabia and is seeking a Finance Manager to establish and coordinate the finance function for Alan Saudi. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and offers an opportunity to build a finance setup from the ground up in a new market. The role requires strong technical reporting skills combined with an understanding of local insurance practices, regulations, and the Saudi operating environment. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. The Finance Function at Alan The Finance & Strategy teams at Alan are integral to supporting decision-making across all levels of the company within a regulated and evolving business landscape. The aim is to translate strategic goals into credible plans, ground financial realities, and foster a company-wide understanding of performance. The Finance Manager will be responsible for building a compliant and reliable finance function for Alan Saudi, serving both the local business launch team and Alan's Group Finance team. Key Responsibilities Define the local finance operating model, clarifying responsibilities between Alan Saudi, Group Finance, and external providers. Establish necessary processes for entity operation, incorporating local insurance, Sharia, and Takaful requirements. Coordinate local financial statements, management reporting, and reporting for Group consolidation, ensuring accuracy and consistency with IFRS 17 and Saudi requirements. Provide financial information for licensing, regulatory submissions, and ongoing reporting to the Insurance Authority. Collaborate with Group Finance, Risk, and Actuarial teams to delineate ownership between local and Group teams. Work with Group Treasury and the Saudi team on banking setup, initial capital injection, cash management, and primary payment flows. Act as a finance partner to the Saudi leadership team, translating reporting into actionable business insights. Document accounting policies, reporting processes, provider responsibilities, regulatory requirements, and key finance decisions. Select and manage local accounting, tax, audit, and other finance providers, setting deliverables and reviewing their work. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a finance role, preferably within the insurance sector or a regulated environment. Strong technical reporting skills and a solid understanding of IFRS 17. Familiarity with local insurance practices, regulations, and the Saudi operating environment. Ability to coordinate external providers and ensure adherence to quality standards. Experience in building and scaling finance functions is advantageous. Work Environment The role involves working within a local team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to launch and operate an insurer for the Kingdom. It will be hands-on during the initial build phase and will evolve as the Saudi business grows and the local team and provider model mature. The position requires coordination with Alan's Group Finance team and various external local providers. Application Process Alan prioritizes hiring individuals based on their capabilities and potential. This job description serves as a guide for the role. We encourage qualified candidates to apply.

1b11ed8b182ebf1d.description: About the Role Albilad Holding Company is seeking a B2B Sales Executive fluent in Mandarin to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role focuses on securing new business for logistics, transportation, and heavy equipment rental services within Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will manage the entire sales cycle, from initial client engagement to confirmed purchase orders. Key Responsibilities Identify and approach prospective clients, including contractors, project owners, and industrial companies. Build and maintain relationships with Mandarin-speaking procurement teams, project managers, and site representatives in Saudi Arabia. Lead client meetings in Mandarin and prepare business correspondence in Simplified Chinese. Confirm service requirements, schedules, and site conditions prior to preparing quotations. Collaborate with operations to verify vehicle and equipment availability, service scope, and delivery timelines. Prepare quotations, negotiate within approved commercial terms, and follow up until a purchase order is issued by the customer. Hand over confirmed orders to operations, ensuring all agreed scope, schedule, and customer requirements are communicated. Maintain current sales records and provide weekly reports on active quotations, expected orders, and planned next steps. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in B2B sales. Proficiency in Mandarin, both spoken and written (Simplified Chinese). Demonstrated ability to develop new business and manage sales opportunities from inception to close. Experience in logistics, transportation, or heavy equipment rental services is preferred. Work Location This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, with responsibilities extending across Saudi Arabia to engage with Mandarin-speaking clients. Application Process To apply, please complete the Jotform application and upload your updated CV. Include a brief example of a B2B sales opportunity you managed and how you utilized Mandarin to advance it.

1bc71d0fbaf52288.description: About the Role Napco National is seeking a Sales Executive to join its team in Khamis Mushayt, 'Asir. This full-time position is ideal for individuals with 1-2 years of experience who are looking to develop their career in sales within a dynamic environment. The Sales Executive will be responsible for managing customer accounts, driving product sales, and ensuring effective market presence. Key Responsibilities Sell the company's full range of products to assigned customers and provide feedback on competitive activities within the designated area. Ensure the proper implementation of planograms. Issue special order requests as needed. Collect invoices in accordance with the company's aging policy. Prepare all necessary documents for the call cycle or business review before market visits. Identify and report new customers in the area to the team leader. 1bff93ed9a18eee0.description: About the Role Cyber is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cybersecurity Manager to join its team in Jeddah. This full-time role requires a strategic thinker with deep technical expertise and leadership capabilities to manage cybersecurity programs across complex environments. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in designing, implementing, and managing robust cybersecurity postures. Role Overview The Cybersecurity Manager will lead security teams, operate at a deep technical level, and collaborate with executive leadership, clients, and stakeholders. The primary objective is to ensure strong cybersecurity posture and compliance with both local and international standards. This position involves a blend of technical operations, strategic planning, and team leadership. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage end-to-end cybersecurity operations, including SOC, incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management. Design, implement, and continuously improve information security frameworks, policies, and procedures. Oversee risk assessments, penetration testing, and security assessments, ensuring timely remediation. Manage and respond to cyber incidents, leading investigations, root cause analysis, and post-incident reporting. Ensure compliance with regulatory and industry standards such as NCA, ISO 27001, NIST, SAMA, and PCI-DSS. Collaborate with internal teams and clients to align cybersecurity strategies with business objectives. Lead, mentor, and develop cybersecurity engineers and analysts. Evaluate, implement, and manage security tools and technologies including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, DLP, and IAM. Prepare executive-level security reports, dashboards, and risk summaries. Stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity trends. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in cybersecurity. Strong blend of technical expertise, hands-on operational experience, and leadership capabilities. Proven track record in designing, implementing, and managing cybersecurity programs across complex environments. Ability to operate at a deep technical level while also thinking strategically. Work Environment and Growth This role offers the opportunity to work with a leading cybersecurity organization in the region, engaging in high-impact, national-level, and enterprise cybersecurity projects. The company supports continuous learning, certification, and career growth within a collaborative, innovative, and professional work environment.

1b5ebfde7bc1c6db.description: Project Manager, Mobility AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Project Manager to lead the delivery of strategic public transport advisory assignments. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and primarily supports the Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites (RCMC) in the development and expansion of the Makkah Bus network. The role requires over 10 years of experience in relevant fields. Role Overview and Key Responsibilities The Project Manager will be responsible for the successful delivery of two primary workstreams under the Makkah Bus project. This includes managing the long-term strategy for network expansion and overseeing the strategic procurement advisory process for the Makkah Bus Operations and Maintenance (O&M) contract renewal. The successful candidate will act as a senior client-facing project manager, coordinating technical, operational, commercial, and procurement activities while maintaining strong relationships with RCMC and other key stakeholders. Makkah Bus Network Phase 2 Strategy (Task 2) Lead strategic assessment and planning for Phase 2, developing a 15–20-year network roadmap. Assess future demand, network coverage, service capacity, fleet, and infrastructure requirements. Develop strategies to expand the fleet from approximately 400 to 1,000 buses. Evaluate network and operating models, including conventional bus and BRT services. Coordinate multidisciplinary inputs to ensure recommendations are commercially viable, operationally sustainable, and aligned with RCMC objectives. Present recommendations and implementation roadmaps to the client. Makkah Bus O&M Procurement Strategy and Contract Renewal (Task 3) Lead project management and client engagement for the renewal of Makkah Bus O&M arrangements. Manage market engagement with operators, investors, and other private-sector stakeholders. Develop and evaluate alternative procurement, contracting, and private-sector participation models. Assess packaging options covering BRT and regular bus operations, fleet procurement/financing, depots, and infrastructure. Develop appropriate allocation of operational, commercial, and financial risks. Recommend procurement strategy based on value for money, market attractiveness, operational efficiency, and long-term sustainability. Manage preparation and presentation of key recommendations to RCMC. Client and Project Management Act as the primary day-to-day interface with RCMC for Tasks 2 and 3. Manage scope, program, budget, resources, deliverables, and risks. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and technical specialists. Lead client meetings, workshops, steering committees, and stakeholder engagement. Ensure timely, high-quality delivery and proactively manage project risks. Regional Mobility Portfolio and Business Development Approximately 25% of the role will involve supporting the wider Western Region Mobility portfolio, including: Supporting mobility and public transport projects across Makkah, Jeddah, Medina, and Abha. Providing leadership across bus operations, transport planning, BRT, and mobility advisory assignments. Supporting business development, client relationships, bids, and proposals. Identifying opportunities to expand the company's mobility portfolio in Saudi Arabia. Supporting regional capability development and knowledge sharing.

1b6fb17731dccab5.description: About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for serious diseases. The company operates with a scientific and patient-focused approach. Role Summary The AI & Digital Excellence Director will lead AstraZeneca Saudi Arabia's transformation towards a customer-centric, data-driven, and AI-enabled organization. This full-time role involves providing strategic direction and integration across Customer Engagement, Business Excellence, Launch Excellence, and Data, Insights & Analytics to ensure digital capabilities and new ways of working translate into measurable customer and business impact. The position requires over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Set the market AI and digital excellence strategy, priorities, and governance, aligning with country business objectives and enterprise direction. Build organizational AI literacy, data fluency, and digital ways of working while ensuring responsible and compliant adoption. Lead, develop, and integrate Customer Engagement, Business Excellence, and Data, Insights & Analytics capabilities as a connected ecosystem. Partner across Commercial & Medical functions to embed transformation into strategy and execution. Collaborate with Customer Engagement to lead the evolution of function and go-to-market models, strengthening omnichannel orchestration, personalization, and connected customer experiences. Ensure Digital Solutions translate customer and business priorities into scalable, compliant, and measurable digital experiences and solutions. Provide strategic direction for Business Excellence, including segmentation and targeting, sales-force effectiveness, performance management, incentives, field productivity, and resource optimization. Champion launch and execution excellence across therapy areas, ensuring disciplined cross-functional readiness and measurable performance. Build Data, Insights & Analytics as a strategic business capability, advancing predictive, actionable, and AI-enabled decision-making. Identify and prioritize high-value AI, automation, and process-transformation opportunities, driving adoption, scale, and measurable value realization. Work Environment AstraZeneca in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is undergoing a significant transformation focused on advancing healthcare, innovation, and sustainable growth. This involves evolving operations to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to Saudi Vision 2030. The company is investing in talent, digital solutions, and new ways of working to enhance patient outcomes and reinforce leadership in therapeutic areas. This dynamic environment seeks professionals who thrive in change and are motivated to shape the future of healthcare in KSA. Why AstraZeneca? AstraZeneca is committed to being a workplace where employees are empowered to advance science and develop their skills. The company fosters an inclusive culture that values diversity and collaboration, with a focus on continuous learning and growth.

The role focuses on sales and business development for container cold storage solutions, leveraging technical expertise to meet customer needs, and managing customer relationships. Key Responsibilities Identify and target potential customers across various industries requiring container cold storage solutions. Develop and implement sales strategies to generate leads and convert them into sales opportunities. Conduct market research to identify trends, competitors, and potential business opportunities. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline, ensuring the CRM system is regularly updated with accurate information. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop promotional materials and campaigns supporting sales efforts. Possess a deep understanding of container cold storage systems, including refrigeration units, insulation, and temperature control. Provide technical guidance and support to customers, assisting them in selecting suitable solutions based on specific requirements. Conduct site visits and assessments to evaluate customer needs and propose accurate and efficient solutions. Collaborate with the engineering team to design and customize container cold storage solutions according to customer specifications. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers, serving as a trusted advisor. Understand customer needs and provide timely, effective solutions to ensure satisfaction and repeat business. Conduct regular follow-ups with customers to address ongoing needs and resolve any concerns. Prepare regular sales reports, including forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance metrics. Analyze market trends, customer feedback, and competitor activities to identify areas for improvement and growth. Provide insights and recommendations to management to enhance sales strategies and achieve business objectives. Required Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. 1b8eeb84e06cc17c.description: About the Role Hays is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer (NIST Specialist) to join their team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This is a contract position requiring 2-5 years of experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for guiding and driving the implementation of the National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF) within the organization. Role Overview The Cybersecurity Engineer will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for NIST CSF, focusing on evaluating the organization's current security posture, identifying and addressing capability gaps, and integrating NIST best practices into the overall cybersecurity strategy. This role involves both strategic guidance and hands-on support to ensure robust cybersecurity implementation. Key Responsibilities Assess the organization’s current security posture against the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). Identify security gaps and develop actionable plans to address them effectively. Provide expert guidance and practical support for implementing NIST CSF requirements. Assist in the development of policies and procedures that are closely aligned with NIST CSF. Conduct periodic assessments to measure the effectiveness and maturity of NIST CSF implementation. Deliver targeted training and awareness sessions on NIST CSF to various departments within the organization. Stay informed about the latest updates and developments within the NIST CSF landscape. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on NIST CSF. Demonstrated experience in evaluating security postures and implementing cybersecurity frameworks. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Dhahran, Eastern region. The role requires a dedicated professional capable of working independently and collaboratively within a project-based environment. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Configure and customize PAM, IAM, MFA, and AD/DNS solutions according to client specifications. Build and maintain identity policies, covering privileged access, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management. Collaborate with security, IT, and compliance teams to ensure seamless integration of identity services. Provide training, support, and documentation to clients for implemented solutions. Liaise with vendors such as Delinea, Microsoft, and One Identity for technical and platform-related matters. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in Digital Identity and Access Management. Demonstrated experience with PAM (Delinea), IAM (One Identity), MFA (Azure MFA & FortiAuthenticator), and Active Directory/DNS. Ability to gather requirements, configure solutions, and advise on best practices. Career Development and Environment Accenture Security offers a transparent and fast-paced approach to career progression, focusing on individual strengths and providing continuous coaching from senior colleagues. Consultants will work alongside Accenture experts, addressing industry challenges with innovative thinking and pioneering tools. The role provides access to state-of-the-art technology, fostering skill development and contributing to the latest business trends. Flexible work arrangements and competitive rewards are part of the benefits package. Location This position is based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

1b5853247ae4b083.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، تحديد القطع التبديلية، وتشخيص أعطال المحركات وإصلاحها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة عمل المحركات الميكانيكية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: متابعة عمليات تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية المخصصة للخدمة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات الميكانيكية ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات. معرفة قوية بتركيب المحركات الميكانيكية وتشغيلها. القدرة على تحديد القطع التبديلية ومطابقة مواصفاتها. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاح المحركات. بيئة العمل يعمل فني ميكانيكي المحركات ضمن فريق شركة مجموعة المجال العربي في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

1b97b882045e5461.description: About the Role Target Engineering Construction Co LLC is seeking a qualified and detail-oriented Electrical QC Inspector to support quality assurance and inspection activities. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, and focuses on major oil and gas EPC projects within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Overview The Electrical QC Inspector will ensure that electrical installation, testing, and commissioning activities comply with project specifications, approved drawings, applicable codes and standards, and client quality requirements. Target Engineering has over 50 years of experience in EPC and industrial infrastructure, delivering large-scale energy, marine, and civil infrastructure projects. Key Responsibilities Conduct inspections of electrical installation activities to ensure compliance with project specifications, approved drawings, and quality requirements. Inspect the installation of cable trays, conduits, power and control cables, transformers, switchgear, lighting systems, junction boxes, grounding systems, and electrical equipment. Verify that electrical works are performed in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), project procedures, and applicable international standards. Witness electrical testing activities, including insulation resistance tests, continuity tests, grounding tests, cable testing, and functional testing. Monitor construction activities, identify non-conformities, and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions. Review electrical inspection records, test reports, and quality documentation to ensure compliance with project requirements. Ensure electrical installations comply with applicable codes, standards, and client specifications. Verify compliance with recognized industry standards such as the National Electrical Code (NEC), IEC standards, IEEE standards, and other applicable international electrical codes. Participate in quality audits, surveillance activities, and client inspections. Coordinate with engineering, construction, commissioning, and QA/QC teams to resolve quality-related issues. Support project handover activities by ensuring all inspection and quality documentation requirements are completed. Witness pre-commissioning and commissioning activities for electrical systems and equipment. Verify that testing and commissioning records are completed and maintained in accordance with project requirements. Ensure punch list items related to electrical quality are properly addressed and closed. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in electrical quality control or inspection. Demonstrated understanding of electrical installation, testing, and commissioning processes. Familiarity with project specifications, approved drawings, and quality requirements in oil and gas EPC projects. Knowledge of applicable codes and standards, including NEC, IEC, and IEEE. Benefits Opportunity to contribute to major Oil & Gas EPC projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. A collaborative and supportive work environment. Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Competitive salary and benefits package. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

1b98aefeef6ecc9c.description: About the Role Ninja Supply Chain Company is seeking an experienced Operations Team Leader to oversee daily warehouse operations at our Central Warehouse. This full-time position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience and focuses on leading frontline teams, coordinating activities, and ensuring operational efficiency and compliance. Role Overview The Operations Team Leader will be responsible for the effective management of daily warehouse activities. This includes supervising team members, monitoring productivity and accuracy, and ensuring adherence to established warehouse procedures, safety standards, and operational targets. The role is critical for maintaining smooth and efficient supply chain operations. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate daily warehouse operations based on shift priorities and operational requirements. Assign tasks to team members and monitor workflow, productivity, and task completion. Supervise warehouse employees, providing guidance and supporting their performance and development. Ensure accurate inventory movements, including scanning, quantity verification, and correct storage locations. Monitor operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), backlog, and workflow efficiency, addressing operational issues promptly. Ensure compliance with warehouse safety standards, quality procedures, and housekeeping requirements. Coordinate with Stock Control, Quality, Safety, and other relevant departments to support smooth operations. Prepare shift updates and report on operational performance, issues, and pending activities. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and support continuous improvement initiatives. Required Experience A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in operations, preferably within a warehouse or supply chain environment. Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate teams effectively. Experience in monitoring operational KPIs and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at Ninja's Central Warehouse. The role involves working closely with frontline teams and collaborating with various internal departments to ensure seamless operational flow. Application Process Interested candidates with the required experience are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

1bbd8ac2954db24d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مستورة للمقاولات عن محامٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم القانوني الشامل للشركة، بدءًا من دراسة القضايا وتجهيز ملفاتها، وصولاً إلى تمثيل الموكلين أمام المحاكم والجهات الرسمية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال القضايا وتحديد نوعها، وتحليل عناصرها، وتقديم الرأي القانوني بشأنها. تحديد وجمع البينات الخطية والشخصية والأدلة ذات الصلة، وإعداد لوائح الدعوى وحافظات المستندات. تسجيل الدعاوى لدى المحاكم المختصة، ومتابعة تبليغ المدعى عليهم، وحضور الجلسات، وتقديم المرافعة حتى صدور الحكم. تمثيل الموكلين (مدعين أو مدعى عليهم) أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم، واللجان الرسمية، والمحكمين، وتقديم المدافعة والإنذارات والمطالبات. المفاوضة بشأن العقود والاتفاقيات مع الجهات الرسمية وغير الرسمية، وصياغتها وتوثيقها لدى الجهات ذات العلاقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير القانونية المتخصصة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة جامعية في القانون. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاماة أو الاستشارات القانونية. معرفة جيدة بالإجراءات القانونية والمحاكم السعودية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على تقييم القضايا القانونية. مهارات ممتازة في صياغة العقود والوثائق القانونية. القدرة على المرافعة والتمثيل القانوني بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل المحامي في هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويكون جزءًا من فريق قانوني يدعم عمليات شركة مستورة للمقاولات. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. يُرجى تقديم طلبك للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

1b18a741dcc24034.description: Chief Investment Officer Role Aventus Global Talent is seeking an experienced Chief Investment Officer (CIO) for a leading financial services business in Riyadh. This is a full-time, senior leadership position responsible for the company’s overall investment strategy, asset allocation, and portfolio performance. The CIO will determine how the business deploys capital, manages liquidity, and balances risk and return across a diversified portfolio. This role involves close collaboration with the CEO and senior leadership team to align investment strategy with the company’s broader financial and strategic objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the company’s overall investment strategy and asset allocation framework. Build and manage a balanced, diversified portfolio across multiple asset classes. Determine strategic and tactical allocations across Private Equity, Fixed Income, Public Equities, Emerging Markets, Real Estate, and other alternative investments. Oversee liquidity and cash management to ensure capital meets company requirements. Develop and maintain investment policies, guidelines, risk parameters, and governance frameworks. Identify and assess external asset managers, investment opportunities, and strategic investment partnerships. Build relationships with global and regional asset managers, private equity firms, investment banks, and other investment partners. Evaluate portfolio performance, risk, and returns, providing recommendations to the CEO and senior leadership team. Ensure the investment portfolio delivers attractive risk-adjusted returns while maintaining appropriate liquidity and capital preservation. Establish a robust investment governance and decision-making framework. Lead the development of the investment function, including building and hiring a high-performing investment team. Monitor global and regional macroeconomic, market, and investment trends and assess their impact on the portfolio. Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, risk, and investment requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of senior-level investment experience within an institutional or financial services environment. Extensive experience across multiple asset classes, including Private Equity, Fixed Income, Equities, Emerging Markets, Real Estate, and Alternatives. Strong expertise in strategic asset allocation, portfolio construction, and risk management. Experience developing investment policies, frameworks, and governance structures. A strong understanding of liquidity and cash management. An established network of relationships with leading global and regional asset managers. Experience managing and developing investment professionals, with the ability to build a broader investment team. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to translate investment strategy into measurable portfolio outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with CEOs, boards, and senior stakeholders. GCC / Middle East investment experience is preferred; international investment experience is highly valued.

1b86c94d6d8119be.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة مصنع كراون جده لصناعة علب المرطبات فرع شركة كراون العربيه عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم العمليات اليومية في المصنع من خلال تشغيل الشاحنات الصغيرة والرافعات الشوكية بفعالية وأمان. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الرافعات الشوكية والشاحنات الصغيرة داخل المصنع. الالتزام الصارم بمسارات العمل المحددة وقواعد السلامة المعمول بها في المصنع. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة على الرافعات الشوكية والشاحنات الصغيرة لضمان جاهزيتها وسلامتها. تقديم المساعدة والدعم في أعمال الإنتاج المختلفة حسب الحاجة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل وقيادة الرافعات الشوكية والشاحنات الصغيرة بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل مصنعية في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور الانضباط والالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة في مصنع كراون جده لصناعة علب المرطبات.

1bdc58440311bf1e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين أثناء تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب واختبار وصيانة الدوائر والعناصر التحكم والآلات الإلكترونية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية ضمن فريق متخصص في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل، مع التركيز على الدقة والجودة في جميع المهام الموكلة إليه. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مجموعة المجال العربي، يرجى تقديم طلبات التوظيف. سيتم مناقشة تفاصيل الراتب خلال المقابلة.

1b06439b2addf9b2.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب المستوى للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقه في الباحة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي ونتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. مهارات في إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية. معرفة جيدة بجداول الكميات والمواصفات الفنية للمواد الإنشائية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الباحة. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في مكتب المستوى للاستشارات الهندسية، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع متنوعة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: الباحة الراتب: غير معلن

1b491a83f3bf3025.description: تعلن Art Leather عن توفر شاغر وظيفي لرسام موهوب ومحترف في الرسم والتخصيص الفني على الأحذية والحقائب الجلدية. المهام الوظيفية: الرسم اليدوي على الأحذية والحقائب. تنفيذ تصاميم فنية مخصصة حسب طلب العملاء. استخدام الألوان والخامات المناسبة للجلود. ترميم الرسومات وتجديدها بدقة واحترافية. المتطلبات: خبرة في الرسم على الجلود والأحذية. مهارة عالية في الرسم اليدوي والتفاصيل الدقيقة. حس فني وإبداعي واهتمام بجودة التنفيذ. تقديم نماذج من الأعمال السابقة

1b36502d7beda826.description: About the Coop Project Management Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Coop Project Management professional to join their team in Jeddah or Makkah. This full-time role is essential for establishing clear ownership and accountability within the Project Management Office (PMO) by effectively distributing responsibilities across project management, governance, planning, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. The objective is to ensure standardized execution, optimal resource utilization, and successful delivery of Operations initiatives. Key Responsibilities Consolidate project requests from various Operations functions. Assess business priorities and obtain director approvals for projects. Coordinate capacity alignment with the TIDES department. Coordinate Project Initiation Document (PID) submissions. Validate project scope and requirements, ensuring proper documentation. Facilitate the development and sign-off of Business Requirements Documents (BRD). Establish comprehensive project plans, including milestones, dependencies, and timelines. Coordinate development, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and go-live activities. Monitor project progress and track key performance indicators (KPIs). Identify and report project delays. Prepare weekly and monthly management reports on project performance. Coordinate with Operations functions, TIDES, project owners, and leadership. Facilitate meetings and follow up on agreed actions to ensure timely completion. Ensure compliance with the PMO lifecycle and governance frameworks. Monitor project risks and manage escalations. Review the effectiveness of PMO processes and implement continuous improvements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage project governance, planning, and reporting. Experience in stakeholder coordination and communication management. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in either Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. 1b8a1a25f9f14196.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ليدر سيستمز عن أخصائي مبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على بيع الحلول التقنية وأنظمة الاتصالات للشركات والمؤسسات، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء لتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي مبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات مسؤولية وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم النتائج وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بمبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات وعرضها وحفظها. المهام الأساسية تحديد واستقطاب العملاء المحتملين في قطاع الأعمال (B2B) وفهم احتياجاتهم التقنية. تقديم العروض الفنية والتجارية للأنظمة والحلول، مثل الشبكات، السحابة الإلكترونية، الأمن السيبراني، أو البرمجيات. التفاوض على العقود والأسعار وإتمام الصفقات لتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية. التنسيق مع الفريق الفني لضمان تسليم الحلول وتنفيذها وفق متطلبات العميل. متابعة رضا العملاء وتقديم خدمات ما بعد البيع لتعزيز فرص التوسع وتجديد العقود. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال مبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات. فهم قوي للحلول التقنية وأنظمة الاتصالات. القدرة على بناء علاقات عمل طويلة الأمد مع العملاء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة في سوق تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

1b7a3af796a38891.description: About the Role Company simsimah alnojum is seeking a Customs Clearance Coordinator to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time position is responsible for managing customs documentation and procedures to ensure the timely release of shipments. The role involves coordinating with various stakeholders and maintaining accurate records. Role Summary The Customs Clearance Coordinator prepares and reviews customs documents, inputs product and goods data into relevant systems, and tracks customs clearance processes until shipments are released. This position requires continuous coordination with licensed customs brokers, monitoring customs transactions, and ensuring the completeness and accuracy of all necessary data and documents to prevent delays and penalties. Key Responsibilities Enter product and item data, along with shipment details, into the FASAH platform and other relevant customs systems. Prepare and review customs documents, including Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bills of Lading, and Certificates of Origin. Review product data and customs classification, determining HS Codes in coordination with the customs broker. Follow up on customs clearance procedures for sea, air, and land shipments. Coordinate with customs brokers, shipping companies, ports, and relevant government entities. Track clearance requests, approvals, and required product certificates based on the nature of each shipment. Ensure the completeness and accuracy of documents and data before submission to authorities. Monitor shipment status and customs transactions, addressing any observations or deficiencies. Maintain and organize electronic customs files and records, ensuring they are updated. Review customs duties, taxes, and costs related to shipments and reconcile them with documents. Prepare periodic reports on shipment status and customs transactions. Stay informed about updates related to customs procedures and systems in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field. 1 to 3 years of practical experience in customs clearance, logistics operations, or import/export. Good knowledge of customs documents and procedures in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Familiarity with HS Codes and product classification is an advantage. Experience in handling sea shipments and their related documents. Proficiency in computer usage and Microsoft Office programs, particularly Excel. Compensation The salary for this position ranges from SAR 3,750 to SAR 5,625 per month. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

1bae48a5ffb6f970.description: About the Role ACWA Power is seeking experienced I&C Engineers for full-time positions within ACWA Operations. The I&C Engineer is responsible for ensuring reliable measurement, control, and protection systems through effective maintenance planning, troubleshooting, and outage support. Key Responsibilities Plan and supervise preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance for instrumentation and control systems. Oversee maintenance and troubleshooting of field instruments, analysers, control valves, DCS/PLC systems, and protection equipment. Provide technical support for RO desalination instrumentation or CCGT turbine, HRSG, steam-water, and balance-of-plant control systems. Coordinate instrument calibration, loop checks, functional testing, and approved protection/interlock testing with Operations. Investigate control-system failures, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement reliability improvements. Manage approved control logic, setpoint, and configuration changes while maintaining accurate technical documentation and system backups. Coordinate maintenance activities, planned outages, work orders through CMMS/SAP, spare parts, and technical evaluations with relevant teams and OEM representatives. Supervise I&C maintenance personnel, provide technical guidance, and ensure compliance with HSE, IMS, and applicable legal requirements. 1b2d21b4d962a770.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد المخاطر في بيئات العمل، وتصميم برامج الوقاية من الأمراض المهنية، وضمان تطبيق معايير الصحة والسلامة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في مواقع العمل. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تنسيق الفحوصات الطبية الدورية للعاملين للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمعايير المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين بيئة العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ جميع أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالمخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في بيئات العمل. القدرة على قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج. فهم لإجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية وتأثيراتها البيئية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد وتقييم المخاطر. القدرة على تصميم وتطوير برامج الوقاية من الأمراض المهنية. مهارات إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. الالتزام بتطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية في مواقع عمل شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات في الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المواقع لتقييم ومراقبة بيئات العمل المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق ملتزم بضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية.

1bb0eb7436d9b58e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رحماء الدولية عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، مع توفير معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات وأسعارها واستخداماتها. يتولى البائع أيضاً مسؤولية معالجة المدفوعات وضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع السلع والخدمات المختلفة للعملاء بفعالية. تقديم معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وميزاتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام لضمان توفر المنتجات، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. تولي عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة واحترافية. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة نقاط البيع (POS) ومعالجة المعاملات المالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة رحماء الدولية في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والتعامل مع مهام المبيعات اليومية في بيئة ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نحن نبحث عن مرشح ملتزم ومتحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

1b1d7312ade371e4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات عن منقذ سباحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان سلامة الأفراد في المسابح والأماكن المائية من خلال المراقبة الفعالة والاستجابة السريعة لأي حالات طارئة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإنقاذ. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة مواقع السباحة، مثل المسابح والبحيرات، لتحديد أي مخاطر محتملة والتعامل معها وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الاستجابة الفورية لحالات الغرق المحتملة عند ملاحظة أي إشارات أو سماع ما يوحي بحدوثها. تقديم الإسعافات الأولية المناسبة للغريق، بما في ذلك تنفيذ عمليات الإنقاذ والرعاية الصحية اللازمة بناءً على حالة المصاب. توجيه السباحين وتقديم النصائح حول الاستخدام الآمن لألواح الغطس والمنزلقات المائية، وتزويدهم بمعلومات حول احتياطات السلامة. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية حول الإنجازات ورفعها إلى المسؤول المختص. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إنقاذ السباحة. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر المحتملة في البيئات المائية. مهارات قوية في الإسعافات الأولية والإنقاذ. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لسلامة المسابح. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل آمنة وداعمة لجميع موظفيها. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات.

1bab26c833415e39.description: About the Role Montblanc is seeking a Sales Associate to join its team in Makkah, with operations also covering Jeddah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on managing sales channels and developing strategies to meet business objectives. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, setting sales targets, and monitoring performance metrics to ensure sales goals are achieved or exceeded. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement relationship management plans for complex potential customer accounts, identifying and building relationships with decision-makers and influencers. Set clear objectives for each sales call, deliver tailored presentations, gather and analyze information, and secure agreement on customer requirements. Cultivate a professional network within the business sector and represent the organization at industry events to gather market intelligence and enhance visibility. Configure complex product-and-service solutions and associated contractual terms that meet customer needs, incorporating input from internal specialists. Present solutions to customer representatives and negotiate agreements within predefined commercial parameters, or review and authorize sales proposals from team members. Manage and deliver pricing and terms projects, negotiating with external strategic partners. Control specific segments of the organization's business performance metrics, ensuring strategic alignment with financial goals. The Sales Associate will work within a dynamic sales environment, engaging with various stakeholders and channel partners. About Montblanc Montblanc is a company recognized for its commitment to quality and excellence. The Sales Associate will contribute to the company's objectives by managing sales channels and fostering strong relationships with customers and partners. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

1be12f8f95d0519b.description: About the Role Modern Mills Company is seeking an Industrial Mechanical Technician to join its team in Khamis Mushayt, 'Asir. This full-time position is designed to support senior mechanical technicians in the maintenance, inspection, and repair of mechanical systems within milling and feed plant operations. Carry out basic lubrication, cleaning, and minor mechanical adjustments as assigned. Support overhaul activities and planned shutdown maintenance works. Accurately document maintenance activities, observations, and completed tasks. Ensure compliance with safety, hygiene, quality, and operational standards. Participate in technical training and skill development programs. Adhere to company maintenance procedures, policies, and compliance requirements. Understanding of safety, hygiene, and quality standards in an industrial setting. Company Culture and Benefits Modern Mills Company offers a professional environment focused on career growth and learning through structured training, mentorship, and cross-functional development. Employees contribute to initiatives supporting food security, sustainability, and digital transformation. The company fosters an inclusive culture that values ideas and teamwork. Compensation includes a competitive salary, comprehensive medical and life insurance, health benefits, and programs supporting work-life balance. The company provides access to advanced technology, process automation, and modern operations. Location This position is based in Khamis Mushayt, 'Asir. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1be32a4b019d862d.description: About Bechtel Corporation and Expo 2030 Riyadh Bechtel Corporation, established in 1898, has a long history of completing over 25,000 projects across 160 countries. The company focuses on delivering successful outcomes for customers in various markets, including Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals; and Manufacturing and Technology. Bechtel is currently collaborating with Expo 2030 Riyadh Company (ERC) to manage the infrastructure program for Expo 2030 Riyadh, a global event promoting sustainable development and innovation. The Expo, themed “Foresight for Tomorrow,” will be held from October 2030 to March 2031 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is expected to attract over 40 million visits. The Project: Expo 2030 Riyadh Infrastructure The Expo 2030 Riyadh project involves a 6 km2 Masterplan that includes early works, utilities, and publicly accessible spaces such as streets and parks. The exhibition space covers 491,100 m2 GFA, accommodating up to 197 participating countries and 29 international organizations. Following the six-month event, the site will transition into a mixed-use legacy development. The project’s master plan incorporates international sustainability standards for urban afforestation, treated water, and energy sources. This full-time Logistics Lead role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: Logistics Lead The Logistics Lead assists in integrating specialized environmental requirements into the planning, permitting, design, and construction phases of the Expo 2030 Riyadh Project. This role involves developing and implementing the environmental inspection program under the guidance of the Environmental Manager, providing technical oversight for the project’s environmental compliance activities by identifying inspection requirements. The position also coordinates with construction leads and delivery package HSE Managers to ensure environmental requirements are addressed in their work products and activities, and assists in developing and implementing a project-level environmental inspection and audit program that meets ISO 14001 requirements. Key Responsibilities Provide assistance to project and construction management in identifying and complying with project environmental procedures and addressing environmental issues. Coordinate with and provide technical assistance to delivery package HSE Managers regarding compliance with project-specific environmental requirements through package-specific inspection programs. Offer technical support and assistance directly to construction supervision and subcontractors in planning and executing field activities in accordance with project environmental requirements. Draft environmental awareness training programs and inspection reports under the direction of the Environmental Manager. Conduct environmental compliance inspections of project construction activities to monitor adherence to environmental requirements, including contractual commitments, EIA, permits, and the project’s CESMP. Carry out audits of environmental compliance implementation by the delivery packages (compliance with contract, CESMP, EIA & EMS). Track environmental compliance with approved plans, laws/regulations, permits, and contract requirements. Assist in the execution of the environmental component of an ESH Program, including technical and administrative aspects. Help prepare and implement Environmental Management Plans, associated environmental plans and procedures, and training programs. Provide input to Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Subcontracts, Commissioning, and other groups to ensure environmental requirements are integrated within project planning and execution. Interpret environmental requirements and provide comprehensive assistance on plan preparation, risk assessment, and program execution. Research moderately complex issues and regulatory requirements, perform studies and environmental assessments, and prepare documentation and reports. Provide support and guidance for environmental permitting, risk assessment, audits, and reviews involving site conditions, natural resources, cultural resources, and communities. Participate in emergency response and incident investigation and resolution. Participate in meetings with customers, team members, subcontractors, permitting agencies, and other stakeholders. Conduct inspections and environmental monitoring and sampling to identify risks, evaluate mitigation measures and corrective actions, and assess compliance with contract, regulatory, project, and Bechtel requirements. Provide guidance regarding environmental mitigation, permitting, sustainability concepts, and protection of environmentally sensitive areas, species, and communities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for the Logistics Lead position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role requires the ability to work under supervision from the Environmental Manager and to coordinate effectively with various project teams and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of environmental compliance, inspection programs, and ISO 14001 requirements is essential for this role.

1b0bf85ec20d403d.description: Support the planning, coordination, and execution of Group-wide cross-selling initiatives across the Bank and its subsidiaries. Identify implementation gaps, operational challenges, and process improvement opportunities, and coordinate their resolution with relevant stakeholders. Support the preparation and coordination of governance committees, management updates, and executive-level progress reports. Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint, including executive-level reporting and presentations.

1b0d7a74c0d8b384.description: About Egis (KSA) Egis is a global consulting and engineering firm specializing in construction, transport, and mobility services. The company focuses on creating and operating intelligent infrastructure and buildings to support the transition to a low-carbon economy and contribute to sustainable territorial development. Egis is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming all qualified applicants. The Role of Document Controller Egis (KSA) is seeking a Document Controller to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This permanent role is central to project operations, ensuring the seamless flow of technical documentation, drawings, and correspondence within the organization and its stakeholder network. The Document Controller's attention to detail and analytical skills will support project efficiency, compliance, and overall success. Key Responsibilities Coordinate all aspects of document control, including registration, uploading, transmitting, and tracking technical documents, drawings, and commercial correspondence across multiple platforms. Ensure the accuracy and compliance of all document data in alignment with internal procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. Manage the flow of documentation within the organization and between external project stakeholders, maintaining transparent communication channels. Retrieve, organize, and distribute files efficiently to team members across multiple disciplines and departments. Develop, implement, and customize electronic workflows to streamline document submissions, approvals, and version control processes. Monitor document quality proactively, identify discrepancies, and implement corrective actions to maintain process integrity. Prepare comprehensive reports on project documentation status, deliverables, and key metrics to support informed decision-making. Collaborate with engineers, contract administrators, and project teams to understand documentation requirements and optimize workflows. Maintain organized filing systems and databases, ensuring easy retrieval and accessibility of critical project information. Perform administrative and project support tasks as required, demonstrating flexibility and a collaborative team-oriented approach. Qualifications and Experience University degree or College diploma in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum of 8 years of professional experience supporting engineering, construction, or infrastructure projects. Proficiency in document control processes with a strong understanding of quality and compliance standards. Demonstrated expertise with collaborative software tools such as SharePoint, ProjectWise, Aconex, Unifier, or equivalent platforms. Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders. Advanced problem-solving abilities and an analytical mindset. Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and verification. Self-starter mentality with a proactive approach to process improvement and innovation. Preferred Attributes Experience with engineering documentation standards and best practices. Familiarity with document tracking systems and version control protocols. Knowledge of project administration and quality management systems. Experience working in fast-paced, multicultural, or international project environments. Certification in document management or information governance. Experience with electronic workflow automation and customization. Demonstrated track record of implementing process improvements that enhance efficiency and compliance. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

1b247f54bc120637.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة بيئة الابداع للمقاولات عن رئيس طهاة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع العمليات في المطبخ، بما يضمن جودة الأداء والالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الطهي والإشراف. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على الطهاة والعاملين في المطبخ، وتوجيههم لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. متابعة وتطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية داخل المطبخ. إعداد مكونات الوجبات الرئيسية والمقبلات، والإشراف على عملية تحضيرها وتقديمها. تحديد أسعار الوجبات بناءً على التكاليف ومعايير السوق. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية التي توضح أداء المطبخ والتقدم المحرز. تطوير الفريق إعداد خطط وبرامج عمل مفصلة لفريق المطبخ. متابعة أداء الطهاة وعمال المطبخ بشكل مستمر. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية النوعية للفريق وتنمية مهاراتهم لضمان التطور المهني المستمر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الطهي والإشراف على فرق المطبخ. معرفة قوية بمعايير السلامة الغذائية والصحة المهنية. القدرة على إدارة فريق العمل وتوجيهه بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في منطقة القصيم، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي في بيئة مطبخ احترافية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى مؤسسة بيئة الابداع للمقاولات.

1bc1a3cd13b3e13d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لانا الطبية عن عامل فرز منتجات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فرز المواد المختلفة خلال مراحل الإنتاج وضمان بيئة عمل نظيفة ومنظمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في سير العمليات التشغيلية بسلاسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فرز المواد وتوزيعها على المناطق المخصصة بناءً على خصائصها مثل الحجم والنوع والحالة والدرجة. تفريغ حاويات المواد التي تم فرزها أو تغييرها حسب متطلبات العمل. تحميل المواد في خطوط الإنتاج أو الأحزمة الناقلة المناسبة لضمان استمرارية عمليات الإنتاج. الحفاظ على نظافة مناطق العمل، وتنظيف الآليات والمعدات والأدوات المستخدمة، وإزالة البقايا والمخلفات. تحميل وتفريغ حاويات المنتجات المصنعة. وضع المواد غير المرغوب فيها على الأحزمة الناقلة المخصصة لإزالة النفايات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة والصحة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل في بيئة إنتاجية والتعامل مع مهام الفرز المتنوعة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة إنتاجية في شركة لانا الطبية بالدمام. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالتعليمات والعمل الجماعي لضمان كفاءة عمليات الفرز والإنتاج. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام الراتب: غير معلن

1bce4da1a1adeae3.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking an EHS Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires an ARAMCO-approved EHS Supervisor with a background in oil and gas experience. The role focuses on establishing, monitoring, appraising, and coordinating an integrated health, safety, and environment management system for construction projects, ensuring compliance with ISO-45001:2018, ISO14001:2015, and ISO 9001 standards. Key Responsibilities Prepare all EHS-related documents, including EHS plans, emergency response plans, and risk assessments. Attend all EHS meetings with clients and project teams. Report all EHS-related issues to the Head Office. Provide EHS induction training to new workers. Conduct daily EHS inspections for assigned zones. Ensure appropriate safe work permits are obtained by Engineers/Supervisors from Clients/Main Contractors. Conduct risk assessments throughout the site and inform Site Engineers and/or Clients/Main Contractors of high-risk areas. Ensure toolbox talks are properly delivered by Engineers weekly to promote EHS awareness among workers. Verify that all personnel wear personal protective equipment, including helmets, EHS shoes, and coveralls. Ensure equipment such as ladders and scaffolding are in good working condition before use. Maintain satisfactory health and hygiene conditions for workers, including water availability, rest areas, and adequate lighting and ventilation. Ensure proper housekeeping on project sites to prevent incidents and accidents. Conduct Job EHS Analysis on high-risk activities to minimize hazardous conditions. Encourage workers and engineers to implement EHS practices. Conduct investigations with engineers in case of minor or major incidents/accidents and communicate results for future precautions. Administer first-aid and/or seek medical assistance in case of worker injury. Maintain all documentation related to EHS activities. Conduct EHS training programs for engineers and workers on-site and participate in HR-organized EHS training programs. Perform hazard identification and risk assessment for critical activities, ensuring findings are incorporated into method statements. Prepare EHS Plans and Environment Management Plans. Coordinate external EHS audits and third-party inspections of equipment. Prepare Emergency Preparedness Plans and conduct emergency drills. Facilitate the implementation of the Work Permit System. Coordinate occupational health and welfare measures. Prepare EHS conditions of contract for sub-contractors. Stop work if unsafe practices are witnessed and promote a proactive commitment to action. Carry out monthly project Risk Management Audits and quarterly system audits. Provide EHS reports to the project head and IC Head on current EHS performance status. Qualifications and Experience ARAMCO-approved EHS Supervisor. Experience in the Oil and Gas sector. 0-1 year of relevant experience. Knowledge of ISO-45001:2018, ISO14001:2015, and ISO 9001 standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic construction project environment. The role requires active participation in site activities and coordination with various stakeholders.

1b8c4a3423854e50.description: About Maarif Education Maarif Education is seeking a Social Science Teacher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on educating and inspiring students, fostering a passion for learning, and highlighting the importance of lifelong education. 1bb735f69c199723.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Quality Control Manager to join the Construction Supervision team in Riyadh. This full-time position supports a major landmark development project, focusing on ensuring all works comply with stringent quality, safety, and sustainability requirements. Project Context The project involves the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination development in Riyadh, featuring iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. The Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management to ensure successful operations and long-term legacy objectives. Key Responsibilities Provide support using the Parsons Quality Management System for process optimization, procedure development, data collection, reporting, and training. Interface with senior and executive levels to drive quality process improvement and re-engineering initiatives. Establish project/program quality systems, audit schedules, and facilitate corrective actions. Perform independent audits to ensure compliance with QA/QC programs and analyze findings to identify trends. Support the development and maintenance of corporate quality governance systems. Promote uniform corrective action/preventive action and non-conformance tracking programs. Collaborate with management on quality activities and interfaces. Perform statistical process control and provide technical guidance to junior quality personnel.
